See docs/pilot-001-independent-progress.md. sources.takeaway: pamr balanced.folds permutes each class, cuts it into blocks of K and scatters each block across folds with a runif-based permute.rows; pamr does not export it. randomSurvivalForest 3.6.0 and randomForestSRC keep that variant and add NA-label imputation. SubgrpID 0.10 (2017-02-28) permutes rows with sample(), as CASPEN does. c060 wraps pamr's internal function as a fold vector. No CRAN package searched defines balanced.folds.vec.
sources.limitations: Unofficial mirror of CRAN releases, read statically; nothing installed or executed. The lineage rests on code text and release dates, not on any statement by the 2023 authors. pamr, randomForestSRC and SubgrpID are GPL-licensed; an independent project implementation must not copy this code. pamr 1.57 balanced.folds.R: 1164 bytes, SHA256 146dd46b68cd84a36999adcf3dcd2b845cdc4e2c29dce4a49818bdbcff23bd89. SubgrpID 0.10 cross_validation_functions.R: 58448 bytes, SHA256 6505f7147c001dfa50ef1d8c1d6c05792cc94af7cb79f7a2f2cbfcc53da41c29. See also S19 and docs/pilot-001-open-questions.md.

sources.title: Immune Epitope Database Query API (IQ-API): CDR2/CDR2L HLA-II curated-metadata audit

sources.title: HLA Ligand Atlas: a benign reference of HLA-presented peptides to improve T-cell-based cancer immunotherapy

sources.title: Venkatraman A, Opal P. Paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration with anti-Yo antibodies - a review. Ann Clin Transl Neurol 2016;3:655-663
sources.locator: Abstract; Pathogenesis > Pathology; Treatment > Monitoring progress with antibody titers; Treatment > Prognosis; Conclusions
sources.takeaway: Purkinje-cell loss is massive and often very rapid; antibody titers may not correlate with symptoms and persist after treatment; immunotherapies largely ineffective; evidence on earlier treatment initiation is conflicting.
sources.limitations: Narrative review of small series and case reports; no randomized evidence. Read through the PMC page and Europe PMC abstract, not every cited primary study.

sources.title: Albert ML et al. Tumor-specific killer cells in paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration. Nat Med 1998;4:1321-1324
sources.locator: Abstract (PMID 9809559)
sources.takeaway: Expanded MHC class I-restricted cdr2-specific CTLs in 3/3 HLA-A2.1+ PCD patients; dendritic-cell cross-presentation of apoptotic cells gave a potent CTL response; peripheral activation proposed to contribute to neuronal degeneration.
sources.limitations: Abstract only; three patients; cdr2 rather than CDR2L; proposed mechanism, not demonstrated injury causation.

sources.title: Shams'ili S et al. Paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration associated with antineuronal antibodies: analysis of 50 patients. Brain 2003;126:1409-1418
sources.locator: Abstract (PMID 12764061)
sources.takeaway: All 50 patients had ataxia progressive over weeks to months that stabilized within 6 months; 4/19 anti-Yo patients remained ambulatory; all 7 who improved had antitumour treatment with complete remission.
sources.limitations: Abstract only; retrospective single-laboratory series; outcomes are functional states, not injury rates.

sources.title: Brenner J et al. Predictive Value of Serum Neurofilament Light Chain Levels in Anti-NMDA Receptor Encephalitis. Neurology 2023;100:e2204-e2213
sources.locator: Abstract (PMID 37015822), Results and Discussion
sources.takeaway: Serum and CSF NfL correlated (R = 0.84); in serial samples NfL roughly followed clinical disease activity, albeit with delay; sampling timing limits prognostic use.
sources.limitations: Different autoimmune disease (anti-NMDAR, surface antigen); abstract only; does not establish NfL behaviour in anti-Yo disease.

sources.title: Manson G et al. Worsening and newly diagnosed paraneoplastic syndromes following anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 immunotherapies, a descriptive study. J Immunother Cancer 2019;7:337
sources.locator: Abstract (PMID 31796119)
sources.takeaway: PNS symptoms worsened in 8 of 16 patients with a pre-existing PNS after anti-PD-1/PD-L1 initiation; four patients died from progression of a neurologic PNS.
sources.limitations: Pharmacovigilance series, mostly non-ovarian tumours and mixed PNS types; abstract only; association, not a dose-response measurement.

sources.title: Smyth D et al. Prospective assessment of serum neurofilament light chain in platinum-induced and taxane-induced peripheral neuropathy. BMJ Neurol Open 2026;8:e001312
sources.locator: Abstract (PMID 41509522), Results and Conclusion
sources.takeaway: Serum NfL sampled before each cycle rose with neurotoxic chemotherapy; taxanes caused greater and sharper rises than platinum agents (peak 129.9 vs 31.0 pg/mL).
sources.limitations: 42 patients, 6 on taxanes; peripheral neuropathy context; abstract only.

sources.title: Atkins KJ et al. Postoperative Delirium and Neurocognitive Disorders Associated With Inflammatory and Neuronal Injury Biomarkers. Anesth Analg 2026
sources.locator: Abstract (PMID 42302277), Results
sources.takeaway: NfL was 1.6 times baseline 48 hours after surgery in 79 older surgical patients.
sources.limitations: Older non-oncologic surgical cohort; abstract only; magnitude after gynecologic oncology surgery not established.
